verification_method: Compare the full-project Jira browser XML export with the earlier Jira REST snapshot. REST Markdown is rendered with Python Markdown 3.9; HTML bodies are compared by ordered word/punctuation tokens, external hyperlink URLs and embedded-media filenames. Generated Jira issue macros are reduced to their issue key after checking their target URL. Timestamps are compared to the second because XML omits milliseconds.
limits: XML does not export individual worklog IDs, authors, comments or start times. Per-issue time-spent and estimate totals are compared; six original detailed worklogs remain in the before snapshot.
XML attachment author identifiers use a different format from REST, so attachment authors cannot be compared. IDs, names, sizes and creation times are compared; file bytes are not exported.

REST Markdown and XML HTML rendering differ. Ordered word/punctuation tokens, external hyperlinks and media filenames are compared, not whitespace, list marker formatting, HTML attributes or internal media UUIDs. XML-generated Jira issue macros and their live status badges are normalized to the referenced key; macro targets are checked. Direct Jira links are represented by their visible issue references rather than counted as external links.
XML exposes formal-link type, direction and target keys but not link IDs. Those endpoints are compared.
XML does not expose comment update authors/times, visibility or reaction metadata; these are not verified here.
Issue update times, resolution times, rank and change history change during conversion and are not compared.
